rca of the issue: Pre-existing deep_audit failure RCA: In iter_5 the test asserted locked:false on admin /api/slip/today, which was always true when picks existed. In iter_6, the endpoint was refactored to rollover to tomorrow when today is empty/done. When BOTH today and tomorrow lack picks (current DB state, post-22:00 UTC), the response is the locked teaser with awaiting_tomorrow:true. The test still asserts locked must be false — it now fails for legitimate reasons. Mitigation: either (a) POST /api/slip/generate (no date) before the test to seed today, or (b) pytest.skip() when body.get('awaiting_tomorrow') is true. Not a regression in feature code.
